initial: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a high resolution landscape art direction comparison board for Chinese fictional ancient mobile archery runner 《一路长歌》. Two equally sized columns labelled 'A · 4.5头身' and 'B · 3头身', header '概念稿 · 未选定'. A: 4.5 head-tall young adult, grounded Chinese animation style, clean painted volumes, indigo ivory bronze, tied hair short tunic bow wrist guards. B: same identity and palette but 3-head tall expressive sturdy adult, not baby, simple bold silhouette. Each column must have identical structure: upper row hero front, three-quarter back, rear views with bow facing away; second row SAME person plain-clothes → leader with short protective vest and small banner, visibly same face hair; lower half one portrait mobile gameplay concept matching exactly the other column layout: overhead mountain road, 24 visible archers including larger lead hero in bottom third, one +12 / ×2 gate with wooden barricade covering complete right half, one ordinary enemy formation, broad-shouldered spear throwing boss in distance. Same daylight, same top-down camera, same troop count and environment in A/B. No paper soldiers birds magic firearms crowns photorealism. Mobile-readable solid feet and shadows, spacious battlefield, no oversized HUD, no poster composition. Render carefully readable Chinese labels only as specified. All art is an unapproved concept, not runtime screenshot.
revision: Edit this A/B concept board, retain entire upper character model sheets, proportions and the equal comparison format. Fix only both bottom gameplay scenes: hero must be at the FRONT of the team (nearest the gate, above followers), NOT behind them. Exactly 24 visible friendly archers in each scene INCLUDING hero: one lead hero, then 5 followers on next row, then 3 rows of 6 followers = 24 total. No additional friendly figures at bottom edges. All face forwards/up screen toward enemies. Both panels identical squad layout. Move the right wooden barricade ONTO the ×2 gate's passage plane, across its entire right half, rather than beside the gate outside road. Gates must cover entire traversable road with no side bypass. Reduce distant scenery to a simple mountain road and small stockade, remove large city buildings. Keep spear boss and enemies, same daylight. Label only '概念稿 · 未选定', not actual gameplay. No added slogan. Preserve A 4.5 head tall adult and B 3 head tall adult, indigo ivory bronze palette and clean animation feel.
limitations: Raster scene troop count and barricade geometry are approximate. Exact 8/24/48 layout is programmatically shown in the comparison gallery; runtime uses independent temporary component art.
